A license statement observed on a source page is research evidence, not completed rights clearance for the final edited asset.
No downloaded bytes, original-file hashes, visual inspections or crop inspections exist in this manifest.
Null resolution or license-version fields are deliberately unverified, not inferred.

Each story retains its sourcepack's original unscheduled editorial date/time. The provisional TikTok choice remains sequence 2 at 10:00 Europe/Athens; it does not replace sequence 1 or claim a publishing slot.
Paragraph mappings are proposals. Reuse of one image does not automatically satisfy requirements for a distinct image per scene.
The Frontiers figure collection is one research lead and must resolve into individually selected image components before acquisition is recorded.
Raw publishing history, private analytics and private content-workspace records are excluded.

Nisyros now has an eight-paragraph proposed source mapping only. Dry-stone wall visibility for paragraph 7 and the daylight closing proposal for paragraph 8 remain unresolved; no sourcepack scene prompt or publishing slot was changed.
